c.request: Among scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing `chronotag` as text) that link to a site via `zoneref`, group by site code and the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`), and get each group's average GB per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`, skipping missing values) and its scan count. Which groups have an average strictly above the mean of all the group averages? Return nothing if that mean can't be computed. Show the site code, status, average ratio, scan count and the amount by which the group beats the mean, unrounded. Sort by that amount from largest to smallest (missing values last) and return the top 10. Only scans timestamped strictly inside the window are included; scans exactly at either endpoint are excluded.
c.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS beat_by FROM grp g CROSS JOIN mean_calc m WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

d.request: Scans whose `chronotag` text is strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (string comparison, endpoints excluded) and whose `zoneref` matches `sites.zoneregistry`, grouped by `sites.zoneregistry` and `sites.healtheval`, with per-group average of `gbsize / spanmin` (rows with NULL `gbsize` or `spanmin` excluded) and `COUNT(*)`, filtered to groups whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of all group averages (empty result if that mean is NULL), returning site code, healtheval, average ratio, scan count, and the unrounded difference from the mean, ordered by that difference descending with NULLs last, limited to 10 rows.
d.sql:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
         s.healtheval,
         AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg
  FROM grp
)
SELECT g.site_code,
       g.healtheval,
       g.avg_ratio,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_ratio - st.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN stats st
WHERE g.avg_ratio > st.mean_avg
ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For scans linked to a site (scan `zoneref` = site code) with a timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) strictly after '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly before '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', excluding both endpoints, group by site code and the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each group, work out the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`, ignoring missing values) and the number of scans. Compare each group's average with the mean of all the group averages (return nothing if that mean can't be computed), and keep only the groups strictly above it. Show the site code, status, average ratio, scan count and the amount by which the group's average exceeds the mean, unrounded. Sort by that amount from largest to smallest (missing values last) and return the top 10.
a.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag::text > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag::text < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval), stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - st.mean_avg AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE g.avg_ratio > st.mean_avg ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

b.request: Scans with `chronotag` text strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', joined to `sites` on `zoneref = zoneregistry`, grouped by `zoneregistry` and `healtheval`, with average `gbsize / spanmin` (non-null only) and `count(*)` per group, returning groups whose average exceeds the mean of group averages, showing the excess over that mean, sorted descending with nulls last, limited to 10.
b.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.healtheval, s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), grouped AS (SELECT zoneregistry, healtheval, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM filtered GROUP BY zoneregistry, healtheval) SELECT zoneregistry, healtheval, avg_ratio, cnt, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM grouped) AS excess_over_mean FROM grouped WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM grouped) ORDER BY excess_over_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
